summary.text: Amy Regier is a Republican state representative from Montana House District 6 who took office in January 2021 and is running for Montana State Senate District 4 on November 3, 2026.
A registered nurse, she chairs the House Judiciary Committee.

paragraphs.text: Amy Regier graduated from Flathead High School and earned a degree from the Montana State University College of Nursing.
Her career experience includes working as a registered nurse with Kalispell Regional Medical Center.
Regier assumed office in the Montana House on January 4, 2021, and chaired the House Judiciary Committee in the 2023-2024 and 2025-2026 sessions.
In the 2025-2026 session she also served on the House Rules, House Legislative Administration and Human Services committees.

She is not seeking re-election to the House; she advanced from the June 2, 2026 Republican primary for State Senate District 4 and faces Democrat Kyle Waterman in the general election, in a race with no incumbent.
